title: S3.7c SAB 21800 coedge-oriented endpoint identities and chain continuity

scope.public_projection: DRW_AcisFaceLoop retains coedge traversal start/end vertex node identities, separately from raw edge-order endpoints.

derivation.forward_sense_0: coedge start/end use raw edge start/end
derivation.reversed_sense_1: coedge start/end use raw edge end/start
derivation.missing_raw_endpoint: the corresponding derived endpoint remains -1 independently

endpoint_chain_observation.closed_ring: compares every oriented coedge end with the following coedge start, including the final-to-first join
endpoint_chain_observation.known_discontinuity: records count and first preceding coedge node and marks projection coverage as a known gap
endpoint_chain_observation.meaning: topological vertex identity continuity only, not geometric curve or pcurve continuity

source.title: ACIS Modeling Software Topology Manual, Model Topology / Coedges
source.used_for: A coedge traverses its edge either in the same or reverse direction. The numeric forward/reversed mapping follows the already-retained SAB boolean interpretation and is not independently asserted as a native-kernel result.

scope.compatibility_boundary: Raw DRW_AcisEdge start/end fields remain unchanged. New face-loop rows apply only coedge-to-edge direction and do not infer face-normal-relative winding.
